name: gograph
description: AST-aware Go code analysis for AI agents. Provides 60 query, analysis, and workflow capabilities (64 MCP endpoints including session lifecycle) covering call graphs, blast radius, interfaces, type usage, architecture boundaries, policy checks, diagrams, error flow, and local workflow telemetry. Replaces broad grep-based exploration with token-efficient structural queries. Respects .gitignore and skips AI agent worktree directories automatically.
author: ozgurcd
